data.title: 伽玛 · 巧克力新品发布会
data.description: 发布会开始前，伽玛在四越商会的展台前揭开绸布，露出摆放整齐的巧克力礼盒。她俯身检查包装，脸上带着满意的微笑。
data.location: elegant product launch hall with a chandelier and a display table of chocolate gift boxes
data.action: standing alone at a display table, lifting a cloth from a chocolate gift box, composed smile
data.lighting: 发布会大厅水晶吊灯的璀璨灯光
data.promptProse: Before the presentation, Gamma stands alone beneath the chandelier and lifts the cloth from a display of Mitsugoshi chocolate gift boxes.
data.animaCaption: Gamma inspects the chocolate display before the doors open.
